conditions: 先在复制前找A与a所在的同源对，再开启S期复制。比较I形与X形、4与8个DNA分子；逐帧解释同源和姐妹不是同一对对象。
Find A and a on a homologous pair before replication, then enable S phase. Compare rods with Xs and4 with8 DNA molecules. Step through why homologues and sisters are different pairings.
assumptions: 高中桥梁：DNA含量可用C描述。此模型复制前2n、2C，复制后2n、4C；n数染色体套数，C比较一套未复制基因组的DNA量，两者不能互换。

Senior bridge: describe DNA content using C. This model changes from2n,2C before S to2n,4C after S. n counts chromosome sets; C compares DNA amount with one unreplicated genome. They are not interchangeable.
L085.originalRights: Original project prose, dataset and SVG; no external asset copied.
L085.scientificLimits: Normal2n4 model beforeS4chromosomes/4DNA; afterS4chromosomes/8DNA. Connected sisters count as one replicated chromosome. Homologue origins separate from sister replication; gene locus alleles distinguished.

conditions: 从S期后播放四步，记录1、1、2、4个细胞的变化。开关交叉互换并翻转第二对方向；观察改变的是DNA片段或组合，不是最终套数。
Play four steps from after S and record1,1,2,4 cells. Toggle crossing over and reverse pair2 orientation. Observe changes in DNA segments or combinations without changing final ploidy.
assumptions: 高中桥梁：未考虑交换时，n对同源的独立排列可产生2^n种整条染色体来源组合，此模型n＝2得到4种潜在组合；不是说一次分裂必产生四种不同配子。

Senior bridge: without crossing over, independent assortment of n pairs permits2^n whole-chromosome origin combinations; n=2 permits4. This does not mean one meiosis must yield four different gamete types.
L086.originalRights: Original project prose, dataset and SVG; no external asset copied.
L086.scientificLimits: AfterS2n4C,4chromosomes/8DNA per cell; afterI n2C,2/4; afterII n1C,2/2. Total8DNA across post-S products. One reciprocal non-sister crossover and two pair2 orientations illustrated; not exhaustive gamete diversity. Equal normal divisions; no nondisjunction.

conditions: 先用Aa×Aa逐格揭示，点选每方配子槽构建一个子代；改为Aa×aa，再用AA×aa。每次记录基因型与显性表型概率。
Reveal Aa×Aa cell by cell and select one gamete slot from each parent to build an offspring. Compare Aa×aa and AA×aa. Record genotype and dominant-phenotype probabilities each time.
assumptions: 高中桥梁：若A不完全显性或共显性，Aa可有不同表型，基因型概率仍可为1∶2∶1，而表型分类改变。连锁和配子选择也会改变更复杂模型的假设。

Senior bridge: with incomplete dominance or codominance, Aa can have a distinct phenotype. Genotype probabilities may remain1:2:1 while phenotype grouping changes. Linkage and gamete selection alter assumptions in more complex models.
L087.originalRights: Original project prose, dataset and SVG; no external asset copied.
L087.scientificLimits: Fictional autosomal monogenic glowbean; complete dominance A for specified phenotype. Each normal gamete carries one locus allele; two equal-probability slots per parent, random combination and equal survival. Genotype sums1; AA/Aa grouped only under complete dominance. No real human trait inference.

conditions: 先设Aa×Aa、样本4、种子42，记期望与实际；换种子43，再把样本设40或120。用至少三批比较解释为何概率不承诺比例。
Set Aa×Aa, sample4, seed42, recording expectations and observations. Compare seed43, then samples40 or120. Use at least three batches to explain why probability promises no exact ratio.
assumptions: 高中桥梁：独立固定概率试验的计数可用二项分布描述。Aa×Aa时，4粒全部非aa的概率为(3/4)^4≈0.316，约31.6%；“看不到aa”并不稀奇。

Senior bridge: independent fixed-probability counts can be described by a binomial distribution. For Aa×Aa, the probability of4 non-aa seeds is(3/4)^4≈0.316, about31.6%; seeing no aa in four is unsurprising.
L088.originalRights: Original project prose, dataset and SVG; no external asset copied.
L088.scientificLimits: Seeded LCG reproducible independent allele draws with replacement; same parents, equal gamete chances and survival. Expected counts=n*p, observation integer. Plot max120; possible sample cap400 in API. Larger sample does not guarantee closer realization; dominant is not stronger/commoner. Real polygenic/environment limits.
